nodes.description: External payable mint function; validates mintActive, supply cap, ETH payment and per-tx limit, then mints sequentially using _getNextUnusedID.
External payable claim; verifies caller owns the old token, escrows it via oldContract.safeTransferFrom, then mints the matching token id.
External payable batch claim; reads all old tokens owned by caller and loops transferring each then minting it.
Internal helper that scans up to 10 candidate ids to find an id unused in both this contract and the old contract.
Internal view helper that calls oldContract.ownerOf in a try/catch to determine ownership of an old token.
External team-only function that forwards the contract ETH balance to the team wallet via SafeTransferLib.safeTransferETH.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal teamWallet before executing the guarded body.
Owner-only function that disables minting.
Owner-only function that enables minting.
Owner-only function that updates the base metadata URI.
View function returning baseURI concatenated with the decimal token id.
Deployer constructor that stores metadata, sets old contract, and airdrops pre-minted tokens to recipients.
Owner-only function that transfers the Ownable ownership to a new address.
Owner-only function that renounces ownership by setting _owner to the zero address.
Internal _mint that validates recipient and unminted id, increments balanceOf in unchecked math and records ownerOf.
EIP-2612 permit; checks deadline against block.timestamp then recovers signer with ecrecover inside an unchecked block.
Counter of tokens tracked by the sale/claim logic.
Boolean flag controlling whether mint is open.
Cursor for the next candidate id used by _getNextUnusedID.
Reference to the legacy ERC721 contract that is queried and transferred from.
Address receiving withdrawn ETH and authorized to call withdraw.
Base metadata URI prefix used by tokenURI.
Ownable owner address used by all owner-only guards.
ERC721 mapping of token id to owner.
ERC721 mapping of address to token balance.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for authorization, ownership and minting recipient.
Block timestamp used as the permit deadline bound.
Low-level call transferring ETH to teamWallet in SafeTransferLib.safeTransferETH.
External call into oldContract.safeTransferFrom performed before state updates in claim and claimAll.
Unchecked arithmetic blocks in mint/_mint/permit that bypass overflow checks.
ecrecover signature recovery that can return the zero address for malformed signatures.
uint16 amount passed to mint controlling how many tokens are issued.
tokenId passed to claim identifying the legacy token to migrate.
from address argument of ERC721 transferFrom.
to address argument of ERC721 transferFrom.
id argument of ERC721 transferFrom.
spender address argument of approve.
owner address signed by permit.
_newOwner address argument of transferOwnership.
_baseURI string argument stored by setBaseURI.
Local supply counter cached in mint and written back to totalSupply.
Local newId obtained from _getNextUnusedID inside the mint loop.
Local array of legacy token ids returned by getPhunksBelongingToOwner.
Cached length of the ownedTokens array used to bound the claimAll loop.
Candidate id local variable iterated inside _getNextUnusedID.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient address to _mint inside mint.
msg.sender is the claimant checked against the legacy token owner in claim.
msg.sender is passed to getPhunksBelongingToOwner and used as mint recipient in claimAll.
onlyTeamWallet authorizes by comparing msg.sender with teamWallet.
withdraw execution is gated by the onlyTeamWallet modifier.
pauseMint requires msg.sender to equal _owner.
startMint requires msg.sender to equal _owner.
setBaseURI requires msg.sender to equal _owner.
transferOwnership requires msg.sender to equal _owner.
renounceOwnership requires msg.sender to equal _owner.
permit enforces deadline >= block.timestamp, making it timestamp dependent.
permit invokes ecrecover to recover the signing address.
claim performs external oldContract.safeTransferFrom before minting the new token.
claimAll performs repeated external safeTransferFrom calls before final state updates.
withdraw performs a low-level ETH call that can reenter the recipient contract.
teamWallet is the destination of the ETH transfer in withdraw.
oldContract state variable is the target of the external safeTransferFrom call.
mint increments supply inside an unchecked block bypassing overflow checks.
mint calls _getNextUnusedID for each token to be minted.
_getNextUnusedID reads and updates nextMintableId.
_getNextUnusedID queries oldContract.ownerOf to detect used ids.
_getNextUnusedID checks the ownerOf mapping for ids already owned here.
mint reads and writes totalSupply.
mint checks the mintActive flag before selling.
claim calls _ownsOldToken to verify legacy ownership.
_ownsOldToken calls oldContract.ownerOf inside try/catch.
claimAll enumerates legacy tokens via oldContract.getPhunksBelongingToOwner.
tokenURI reads baseURI when building metadata.
tokenURI reads ownerOf to ensure the token exists.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
pauseMint sets mintActive to false.
startMint sets mintActive to true.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes out _owner, permanently dropping privileges.
mint calls the internal _mint for each new token.
_mint increments balanceOf inside an unchecked block.
_mint updates the balanceOf mapping for the recipient.
claim mints the migrated token through _mint.
claimAll mints each unclaimed token through _mint.
permit increments nonces[owner] inside an unchecked block.
constructor airdrops tokens by calling _mint for each recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: amount is only consumed by mint's validation and loop bounds.
tokenId is only used within claim for ownership verification and minting.
from is a per-call transfer argument with no independent semantic meaning.
to is a per-call transfer argument bound to the transfer flow.
id is a per-call token identifier confined to the transfer routine.
spender only parameterizes the approval write.
owner is consumed solely by permit signature recovery.
_newOwner is only assigned into the _owner state variable.
_baseURI is only stored into the baseURI state variable.
supply is a temporary accumulator written back into totalSupply.
newId is a loop-local id consumed by the mint routine.
ownedTokens is a temporary array only used to drive the claimAll loop.
length is a cached bound for the claimAll loop.
newId is the scanning cursor internal to _getNextUnusedID.
